expressions.title: The Heavy Industries Board Act, 1997
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extra., June 2, 1997, p.1112) block 1070267 prints 'ACT No. XII OF 1997 An Act to establish a Heavy Industries Board Taxila'; s.1 names it; ss.1-15 run to p6 (p.1117) ending '... and the Board shall accordingly stand dissolved.' The p1 head prints the last sections and signatures of an earlier law whose title is on a page not in this copy: a fragment, set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split'). ACT No. XIII OF 1997 (amending the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956) on p6 is cut off after its enacting formula at the end of this copy and is set aside as apparatus.
